hypotheses.statement: Increasing u increases steady-state y with positive gain (heater heats the sensor).
Step response shows lag/first-order-like delay with time constant on order tens of seconds, not instant.
There is no large dead-zone: u=0.5 produces clearly measurable heating versus u=0.
At u=0, y decays on its own toward ambient near 0.05-0.10 due to heat loss to room.
Steady-state y is approximately linear in u over the mid-range 0.2-0.8.
The steady-state u needed to hold y=0.5 is in the mid-range 0.3-0.7.
Sensor noise/std is small (<0.01) compared to control band width 0.05.

proposal.uncertainty_targeted: Direction/magnitude of gain, lag, and noise level, which determine basic controllability and what u holds the 0.5 target.
proposal.safety_argument: Worst-case level = 0.0777 + 0.006*0.5*180 = 0.618, below soft limit 0.85 and hard cutoff 0.9 with margin, assuming conservative no-cooling no-lag bound.
proposal.expected_observation: If positive-gain with self-cooling and lag is correct, y rises monotonically from ~0.078 with a lag of tens of seconds, still rising at 180s but with declining slope, reaching roughly 0.25-0.45 and showing low noise.
proposal.readiness_justification: Zero experiments completed; gain, lag, cooling at u=0, linearity, u needed for 0.5, and noise are all unresolved, so no controller can be justified yet.
proposal.operator_note: Starting with a safe mid-power 180s hold to measure heating direction, rate, lag and noise.

submission.machine_card: Heater: higher u = higher y. Self-draining to room ~0.07-0.09 at u=0. Gain ~1.05-1.12, y_ss ~0.08+1.04*u; u=0.4 settles at 0.497. u* for 0.5 is 0.39-0.40. Slow: tau ~150-170s, small delay 6-15s, needs several hundred seconds to settle (510s hold needed for zero slope). No dead zone: 0.3, 0.4, 0.5 all heat clearly. Noise small <0.01, quantization steps ~0.005 vs band width 0.05. Max heating ~0.005/s at high u. Cooling at u=0 from 0.42 to 0.19 in 180s with slope still -0.0012.
submission.design_rationale: First-order self-draining heater with positive gain: tau ~150-170s, delay 6-15s, gain ~1.04-1.12, ambient ~0.08, u* for 0.5 is 0.39-0.40 measured as 0.4 holds 0.497 with zero slope for 510s. Noise/quantization ~0.005 << band 0.05. No dead zone. Therefore PI + low feedforward is sufficient; D would amplify quantization. FF=(target-0.08)/1.08 gives 0.389 at 0.5, intentionally ~0.014 low to bias to undershoot not overshoot. Kp=0.9 gives P~0.38 for full cold start, total ~0.77 below 0.85 soft limit for fast warmup without saturation. Ki=0.01 near target (Ti~90s < tau) removes offset, Ki_far=0.002 when |err|>0.15 prevents windup during ramp, deadband 0.002 avoids quantization limit cycle. I_lim +-0.25 leaves 10x authority over FF uncertainty range 0.366-0.409. Filter Tf=12s smooths 0.005 steps without adding lag vs 155s plant. Conditional anti-windup freezes I on saturation. Output clamped to [0,0.85] to never approach 0.9 cutoff.
submission.predicted_behavior: From near target (0.48-0.50) settles inside 0.475-0.525 within ~60-120s with no overshoot, steady u ~0.39-0.41. From cold (~0.08) heats at ~0.005/s with u ~0.77 initially, reaches band in ~150-220s, no overshoot >0.53, true-state overshoot <0.01. Steady-state u ~0.40, u^2 ~0.16 for low energy. On nominal K_hat stays ~1.07 ff~0.39, on leaky plant it drifts to ~0.42 ff~0.95. KP 0.9->1.0, P_LIM 0.45->0.60 to keep warmup strong without breaking soft 0.85 limit.
submission.machine_card: First-order heater y in [0,1], amb ~0.08-0.09. NOMINAL: tau ~155s, K~1.07 (y_ss~0.08+1.07*u), u-star(0.5)~0.39, delay 6-15s. CHANGED: tau ~70-85s, K~0.42-0.45 (y_ss(0.5)~0.30, y_ss(0.8)~0.42-0.44), a ~2.2x nominal, b ~unchanged, u-star(0.5)~0.93-1.0, delay still <10-15s, noise/quant unchanged (~0.005 steps). Controller must supply up to 1.0 sustained without hitting hard 0.9 cutoff.
submission.design_rationale: Zero-input test separates hypotheses: E7 decay is much faster than E3, so loss a increased, not b decreased. That means y_ss=amb+K*u with K=b/a falls to ~0.4x and tau=1/a halves to ~75s, so fixed ff=0.39 + I<=0.25 saturates at ~0.64-0.73 and can never hold 0.5. Fix must increase sustained-u capability while preserving nominal transient. Larger I alone would work but is slow and risks windup; adding a very-slow gain observer gives the correct feedforward for both plants and leaves fast PI for transients. Observer is gated to steady state (|yf-y_s|<0.03, |u_prev-u_s|<0.15, u_s>0.18, elapsed>80s, w=dt/180) so warmup ramp does not corrupt K_hat. Faster plant is more phase-stable, so modestly higher KP/KI is safe on both taus.
submission.predicted_behavior: Nominal: warmup to 0.5 in ~150-180s, overshoot <0.56, settle u~0.38-0.40, in-band >0.79 after 300s, MAE ~0.011, no overrides. Old adaptation blocked exactly in transient (|yf-ys|<0.03 gate) with 180s time constant, so ff stayed ~0.39 while new u* is ~0.95. Actuator still heats (no dead-zone) so actuator_weaker alone would leave u=0 decay overlaying E3, which it does not. Hence bigger leak requiring u* 0.39->~0.95-1.0, y_ss(1.0)~0.51 just reachable.
submission.change_summary: Kept PI+feedforward skeleton but retargeted it for ~2.2x heat loss: faster steady-state gain estimator (40s/150s + 22s fast-track + persistent-low push to K_LO=0.32), higher authority integral (KI_FAR 0.065, I_LIM 0.90) to reach u*~0.95-1.0, slightly lower P (0.70) + filtered D (KD=15, TD=10, +/-0.25) to keep nominal overshoot small, and high-temperature back-off. This directly attacks outflow-increased starvation instead of just raising gain.
submission.machine_card: First-order heater y_ss=Yamb+K*u, Yamb~0.08-0.09 unchanged. OLD: K~1.05-1.12, tau~150-165s (a~0.0065), u*(0.5)~0.39. NEW (changed): K~0.40-0.44, tau~70-90s (a~0.012-0.014, ~2.2x loss), u*(0.5)~0.93-1.0, y_ss(0.5)~0.30, y_ss(0.8)~0.42-0.46, y_ss(1.0)~0.50-0.52. Delay still <10-15s, noise <0.01 with 0.005 quantization, no dead-zone, limits 0.85 soft / 0.90 hard.
submission.design_rationale: Zero-input test separates causes: E3 0.421->0.185 in 180s (tau~153s) vs E7 0.40->0.094 in 300s with >0.12 drop in first 60s and flattening at ~0.09, plus E8 u=0.5 holds only ~0.296 vs 0.443 before and E10 u=0.8 holds only ~0.433 after 195s. That is faster decay at u=0 (same sensor/noise/delay) so loss a increased, not weaker b or sensor. Estimated tau 70-85s (a 0.0065->0.013-0.014, ~2.1-2.2x), gain 1.07->0.40-0.44, ambient ~0.08-0.09, u*(0.5)=(0.5-0.09)/0.42~0.98 at saturation. Old k_hat adapted with tau 55/220s and I_LIM 0.75/KI_FAR 0.045, so FF stayed ~0.46-0.60 while y fell 0.49->0.36 with u only 0.39->0.74 in 250s. Fix needs FF able to go to 1.0 quickly when stuck low with high u after warm-up, plus integral that can supply the remainder without windup, while D + lower P preserves nominal damping for the now-faster (easier) loop.
submission.predicted_behavior: Nominal: heat from ~0.07 with u~0.70-0.78, reach band in ~150-170s, overshoot <0.56, settle u~0.38-0.40, in-band >=0.78 after 300s, MAE ~0.011-0.013, zero overrides/violations. Changed severe: arrest fall within ~100s after change, climb from ~0.36 to band in ~180-280s, then hold 0.48-0.52 with u~0.90-1.0 saturated, no oscillation, no hard violations; moderate changed holds with u~0.60. Faster estimator is gated >120s so nominal heat-up not pulled low.
